extra_vocab.en: in the way that has been done for a long time
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡放在句首，先說明街區「一向」的角色，後面再用 but 帶出近十年的改變，形成今昔對比。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 句首的 traditionally 後面要加逗號，修飾整個句子，常和現在完成式（has been）連用，再用 but 帶出對比。

example.en: Wool is traditionally used for winter uniforms in this region.
example.zh: 在這個地區，羊毛傳統上用來製作冬季制服。

example.en: The district is traditionally known as the city's financial center.
example.zh: 這個街區向來被稱為本市的金融中心。

example.en: The annual fair is traditionally held in the first week of May.
example.zh: 年度市集傳統上在五月第一週舉行。

examples.en: Traditionally, our company has sold its products through local retail stores.
examples.zh: 傳統上，我們公司一向透過當地零售店銷售產品。

examples.en: Traditionally, customers paid in cash, but most now use mobile payments.
examples.zh: 傳統上顧客以現金付款，但現在大多使用行動支付。

examples.en: Traditionally, the sales department has handled all client complaints.
examples.zh: 傳統上，所有客戶投訴都由業務部門處理。

confusable.diff: traditional 是形容詞，修飾名詞；traditionally 是副詞，修飾動詞或整個句子。
confusable.usage: traditional 放在名詞前（a traditional market）；traditionally 修飾動詞或整句（Traditionally, …）。

example.en: The traditional market in the old district still attracts many visitors.
example.zh: 舊城區的傳統市場仍然吸引許多遊客。

similar.diff: historically 強調歷史事實與時間脈絡；traditionally 強調長期形成的慣例與做法。

example.en: Historically, the port has been the region's main source of jobs.
example.zh: 歷史上，這座港口一直是該地區主要的就業來源。

example.en: It is customary to exchange business cards at the start of a meeting.
example.zh: 會議一開始交換名片是慣例。

example.en: The firm uses conventional advertising rather than social media campaigns.
example.zh: 這家公司使用傳統廣告，而不是社群媒體活動。

example.en: The building was formerly used as a warehouse for textiles.
example.zh: 這棟建築以前被當作紡織品倉庫使用。

derived.link: 最基礎的字，像 addition、condition 這類 -tion 名詞

extra_vocab.en: a place or collection where old records or documents are kept
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，an archive of local photographs 指社區中心內保存在地老照片的檔案館，呼應街區的歷史。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 表示「…的檔案庫」常用 an archive of + 所收藏的資料，例如 an archive of photographs。

example.en: The city archives are open to the public on weekdays.
example.zh: 市立檔案館平日開放給大眾。

example.en: The system automatically archives emails older than two years.
example.zh: 系統會自動把超過兩年的電子郵件存檔。

example.en: All signed contracts were archived at the end of the year.
example.zh: 所有已簽署的合約都在年底存檔了。

example.en: Archiving old files frees up space on the company server.
example.zh: 把舊檔案存檔可以釋出公司伺服器的空間。

example.en: The public archive keeps maps and records from the last century.
example.zh: 公共檔案館保存著上個世紀的地圖與紀錄。

example.en: A digital archive makes old reports easy to search.
example.zh: 數位檔案庫讓舊報告很容易搜尋。

example.en: Please archive old files before the server upgrade on Friday.
example.zh: 請在週五伺服器升級前，把舊檔案存檔。

examples.en: The museum's archive contains thousands of photographs from the early twentieth century.
examples.zh: 博物館的檔案庫收藏了數千張二十世紀初的照片。

examples.en: Please archive the signed contracts before the audit begins next week.
examples.zh: 請在下週稽核開始前，把已簽署的合約存檔。

examples.en: Emails older than two years will be moved to the archive automatically.
examples.zh: 超過兩年的電子郵件會自動移到存檔區。

examples.en: Researchers visited the city archive to study old maps of the harbor.
examples.zh: 研究人員前往市立檔案館研究港口的舊地圖。

confusable.diff: 拼法相近，但 achieve 是「達成目標」，archive 是「存放舊資料」或「檔案館」。

example.en: We hope to achieve our sales target by the end of June.
example.zh: 我們希望在六月底前達成銷售目標。

similar.diff: records 泛指各種記錄資料；archive 強調長期保存舊資料的地方或系統。

example.en: Employee records must be kept for seven years under company policy.
example.zh: 依公司政策，員工記錄必須保存七年。

example.en: Please scan each document before sending it to the archive.
example.zh: 請在把每份文件送到檔案庫前先掃描。

example.en: The company keeps a record of every customer order.
example.zh: 公司保存了每一筆客戶訂單的紀錄。

example.en: The library has a large collection of local newspapers.
example.zh: 圖書館有大量的本地報紙館藏。

example.en: The company archive stores every annual report since the year 1990.
example.zh: 公司檔案庫保存了 1990 年以來的每一份年度報告。

example.en: Staff should archive project files once the work is complete.
example.zh: 工作完成後，員工應該將專案檔案存檔。

extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，be underway by March 表示「到三月時工程應該已經開始動工、正在進行」，by + 時間強調最晚的開工時點。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: underway 多放在 be 動詞後面當補語（is underway），通常不放在名詞前；也可寫成 under way。

example.en: The annual sales conference will get underway at nine o'clock.
example.zh: 年度業務會議將在九點開始。

example.en: Renovation work on the lobby is already underway.
example.zh: 大廳的整修工程已經在進行中。

collocations.zh: 進展順利、已進行一段時間

example.en: Preparations for the trade fair are well underway this month.
example.zh: 貿易展的籌備工作這個月已進行得相當順利。

examples.en: The software upgrade is underway, so some systems may be slow.
examples.zh: 軟體升級正在進行中，所以部分系統可能會變慢。

examples.en: The conference is scheduled to be underway by nine in the morning.
examples.zh: 會議預定在早上九點前開始進行。

examples.en: Road repairs are underway near the station, so expect delays this week.
examples.zh: 車站附近正在進行道路修繕，所以本週預期會有延誤。

similar.diff: ongoing 可放在名詞前（an ongoing project），underway 通常放在 be 之後。

example.en: We have several ongoing projects in the Asia-Pacific region.
example.zh: 我們在亞太地區有好幾個進行中的專案。

similar.diff: in progress 較通用，也能放在名詞後面（work in progress）。

example.en: The inspection is in progress, so please wait outside.
example.zh: 檢查正在進行中，請在外面等候。

example.en: The firm will launch the new service next quarter.
example.zh: 公司將在下一季推出新服務。

example.en: Construction will commence once the permit is approved.
example.zh: 許可證核准後，工程就會開始。

example.en: Work will be completed before the end of September.
example.zh: 工作將在九月底前完成。

example.en: The audit is underway, and the final report is due soon.
example.zh: 稽核正在進行中，最終報告很快就要提出。

example.en: The new training program got underway last Monday morning.
example.zh: 新的培訓計畫上週一早上開始進行。

extra_vocab.en: good enough to be worth the time, money, or effort
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，worthwhile investment 說明市府出資是值得的，理由是鄰近城市類似計畫使房價上漲約百分之十二。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: worth 後面直接接名詞或 V-ing（worth visiting），不接 to V；worthwhile 則可用 it is worthwhile to + V。

example.en: Training the new staff was a worthwhile investment for the team.
example.zh: 培訓新進人員對團隊來說是值得的投資。

example.en: The extra hour of planning proved well worthwhile in the end.
example.zh: 事後證明，多花一小時規劃非常值得。

example.en: We hope the new system will prove worthwhile within a year.
example.zh: 我們希望新系統在一年內就能證明是值得的。

examples.en: Management felt the new training program was worthwhile for all employees.
examples.zh: 管理階層認為新的培訓計畫對所有員工都是值得的。

examples.en: It is worthwhile to book early because flight prices rise quickly.
examples.zh: 提早訂位是值得的，因為機票價格漲得很快。

examples.en: The workshop was long, but many participants found it worthwhile.
examples.zh: 工作坊雖然很長，但許多參加者覺得很值得。

examples.en: Upgrading the equipment is worthwhile only if it reduces repair costs.
examples.zh: 只有在能降低維修成本時，升級設備才是值得的。

confusable.diff: worth 是介系詞或形容詞，不能直接放在名詞前修飾；worthwhile 可以修飾名詞。
confusable.usage: worth 後面直接接名詞或 V-ing（worth reading），不說 a worth investment；要說 a worthwhile investment。

example.en: This report is worth reading before the meeting starts on Monday.
example.zh: 這份報告在週一開會前值得先讀。

confusable.diff: worthy 較正式，常用 worthy of，表示「配得上、值得被…」。

example.en: Her proposal is worthy of serious consideration by the board.
example.zh: 她的提案值得董事會認真考慮。

similar.diff: valuable 強調事物本身有價值；worthwhile 強調花時間、金錢或努力是否值得。

example.en: The survey gave us valuable information about local customers.
example.zh: 這份調查給了我們關於本地顧客的寶貴資訊。

similar.diff: rewarding 常指帶來滿足感或收穫，帶有情感色彩。

example.en: Training new employees is a rewarding part of my job.
example.zh: 培訓新進員工是我工作中很有成就感的一部分。

example.en: Flexible hours are one benefit of working for this company.
example.zh: 彈性工時是在這家公司工作的好處之一。

example.en: The company's investment in new software paid off within a year.
example.zh: 公司在新軟體上的投資在一年內就回本了。

example.en: Our location gives us a clear advantage over competitors.
example.zh: 我們的地點讓我們比競爭對手有明顯優勢。

derived.link: worthwhile = worth + while（一段時間），意思是「值得花時間」
worth + -y，變成形容詞，常用 worthy of
